greet.text: Oh! Did you see the worm? There was a worm.
Look, I'm not hiding anything. I'm just standing here.

idle.text: Fact forty-four: worms have no ears. They just feel it.
Is that a bee? That's a bee.
Grandma says carrots take their time. I'm giving them a talking-to.
The blue ones are called harebells. Or 'the blue ones'.
I'm going to say good morning to the statue the second you tell me it's morning.
Nobody ever tells you what the clouds are called.
I'm not tired. I'm resting my eyes.

greet.text: Mind the flowers. Not that they'd mind you.
You'll want a shawl, this time of evening.

idle.text: That hat of his is still on the peg.
The kettle and I have an understanding.
The light's gone the colour of tea.
Somebody ought to oil that gate.
